status: PROPOSED - revised under task P0-D03-002 (v0.0.2): handling classes corrected per the owner-approved classification table in that task; CVE cap 32 and supporting-evidence cap 64 approved by the same task. The complete field model still requires explicit product owner acceptance before P1; no implementation.
classification_policy: Classes follow D07: operational / sensitive / restricted. Only operational and sensitive values may be normalized; restricted content (raw messages, credentials, unrestricted free text) is never an observable.
Classification attaches to the VALUE in context, not to the topic: a public CVE identifier is operational, while a statement linking that CVE to a protected host is sensitive.

Escalation: internal package names, proprietary software identifiers, and any value that reveals protected infrastructure are classified sensitive (or restricted) even where the public counterpart is operational.
Ports remain sensitive: they occur only as part of flows between sensitive endpoints. Protocol tokens are operational.

File hashes remain sensitive in normalized events: in this corpus they arrive attached to host/process context. A hash received as a standalone public CTI indicator is handled at the intel layer, not by reclassifying this field.
